payload.title: Reconstruct historical FRANK loop-of-loops and validate provenance-bound causal re-entry
payload.work_clay: Use research_entity/frank/FRANK_LOOP_OF_LOOPS_CAUSAL_REENTRY_ARCHITECTURE_20260809.md as the current research delta. First recover the historical Frank snapshots/logs around the owner-observed prolonged high-closure regime, including the 2026-03-19 workspace deletion lineage, parent snapshot 3a264068 if available, 2026-08-01 restoration, and candidate pre-break configurations. Build an exhaustive 74-service/module functional/state/policy lineage map rather than trusting current grouped organ names. Reconstruct the time-varying producer-consumer-reentry graph and identify every causal edge that feeds changed receiver/system state back into future workspace selection. Build matched replay probes with truthful, no, temporal-shuffled, receiver-shuffled and provenance-broken re-entry; receiver-stage lesions; response-analyzer/E-PQ/memory/intent/perception/Thalamus/NAc/Amygdala lesions; and rescue. Freeze model output where needed to separate architecture from model stochasticity. Fit a bounded operating envelope over closure, reentry fidelity, recurrence, differentiation, ignition occupancy, saturation, recovery and task outcome. Do not call the target consciousness and do not maximize a single emergence score.
payload.reason_clay: Historical Drive evidence shows state generation continued after the workspace consumer path was severed, and the repaired architecture explicitly closed response->state->next-workspace and slower memory/disposition loops. Current NEW CLAY-FRANK has typed workspace receiver receipts and causal credit, but provenance-bound changed-state re-entry should be made an explicit falsifiable first-class contract. Synthetic controls show that stronger re-entry can improve persistence/memory when provenance-correct but excessive gain produces permanent ignition, synchrony/saturation and effective-rank collapse.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible archaeology receipt identifies the best-supported historical peak configuration or explicitly reports UNRECOVERABLE; all 74 measured historical service/module boundaries are accounted for by RETAIN/FUSE/EMERGENT_DISTRIBUTE/HISTORICAL_FAILURE_LINEAGE with preserved function/state/policy/measurement/causal probes or explicit UNKNOWN; a causal graph and exact loop sketch are generated; golden episodes and counterfactual replay inputs are frozen; truthful-vs-shuffled-vs-no-reentry and required lesion/rescue tests execute with provenance; LoopRegimeReadout and overcoupling controls are executable; H1 instrumentation requirements are frozen without violating current BASE/H1 stage dependencies; no production promotion occurs without receipt-backed evidence.
payload.executor_policy: Archaeology/instrumentation research may proceed immediately using local repo/archive/Drive mirrors and sandbox replay. Any H1/H2/H3 production integration must honor PROGRAM_STATE dependencies and cannot be credited PASS before BASE/H1 gates. Prefer Claude Code local build/execution organ for historical checkout, code instrumentation and real runtime replay; use ChatGPT research organ for external research, synthesis, mathematical model and adversarial review. Preserve raw evidence and negative results. No paid training required.
